sql_templates.explanation: This template retrieves enhanced report metadata and filtered stock data for the last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_runs AS (
    SELECT * FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts > (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days')
), latest_filtered_stocks AS (
    SELECT * FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks
    WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest_runs)
)
SELECT run.run_id, run.stocks_analyzed, run.stocks_filtered, stock.symbol, stock.recommendation
FROM latest_runs AS run
JOIN latest_filtered_stocks AS stock ON run.run_id = stock.run_id
ORDER BY run.run_ts DESC, stock.rank ASC
LIMIT 100;

sql_templates.description: Fetch recent FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_data AS (
    SELECT flows.trade_date, flows.fii_net_today, flows.dii_net_today, flows.flow_signal,
           regime.regime, regime.confidence,
           breadth.advances, breadth.declines, breadth.ad_signal,
           index_data.close
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows flows
    JOIN signals.regime_history regime ON flows.trade_date = regime.trade_date
    JOIN breadth.market_daily breadth ON flows.trade_date = breadth.trade_date
    JOIN market.index_eod index_data ON flows.trade_date = index_data.trade_date
    WHERE flows.trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
    AND index_data.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT * FROM latest_data;

sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest insider alerts and bulk/block deals with confirmed technical setups.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
    i.symbol, i.alert_date, i.alert_type, i.insider_score, 
    b.deal_date, b.price, b.qty, 
    s.stage, s.technical_score, s.trading_signal 
FROM 
    signals.insider_alerts i 
JOIN 
    signals.bulk_block_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol 
JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots s ON i.symbol = s.symbol 
WHERE 
    i.alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days' 
    AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
    AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY') 
ORDER BY 
    i.alert_date DESC 
LIMIT 25;
